verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility means data can be queried and extracted using standard Postgres client tools (e.g., pg_dump-like exports), and it documents backup/restore features for getting data out of a cluster. However, there is no explicit documentation of exporting data to open interchange formats (CSV/Parquet/etc.) for a full migration-and-leave scenario, and community comments note backup/restore capabilities have historically been gated behind enterprise licensing for self-hosted deployments, undermining unrestricted portability. Missing for 10: explicit open-format bulk export documentation, confirmation that full export/leave is unrestricted across all tiers, and independent verification of successful full data migration out of CockroachDB.
